paper_title: Stronger limits on hypothetical Yukawa interactions in the 40--8000 nm range
coupling_convention: alpha (dimensionless Yukawa strength relative to Newtonian gravity)
notes: Casimir-less differential-force (fifth-force) experiment constraining a Yukawa correction to Newtonian gravity, V=-G m1 m2/r * alpha * exp(-r/lambda), over lambda=30-8000 nm at 95% CL. The exclusion is presented in the {lambda, alpha} plane (Fig. 4); no numerical table is given. Coupling values here are ALPHA (Yukawa strength relative to gravity), NOT a canonical dimensionless scalar-nucleon coupling. Data points are rough visual estimates from Fig. 4 and are approximate. Mass computed from reduced Compton wavelength lambda=hbar/mc: m[eV]=197.3/lambda[nm] (e.g. lambda=300 nm -> 0.658 eV, best improvement factor ~10^3).
